[[File:Icon-Objective.png|40px]]

An '''Objective''' is a two-sided [[Star Wars CCG]] card type introduced in [[Special Edition]] (November 1998). It represents a task to complete, carries game text on both sides, and flips over according to its game text, sometimes more than once per game.<ref name="gl20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Decipher Glossary 2.0#Objective cards|Decipher Glossary 2.0]]</ref>

== Rules ==
A deck may include only one Objective. A player who includes one deploys it instead of a starting location, front side up (the side with destiny 0), together with the other cards it requires or allows, for free.<ref name="gl20" />
* If one player reveals an Objective and the other a starting location, the starting location deploys first.
* If both players reveal Objectives, the player who goes first (usually the Dark Side) deploys first.
* The opponent may examine both sides of an Objective at any time.<ref name="gl20" />

Objectives are not [[Effect]]s; see [[Card Type]].

== Origin ==
Former Decipher lead designer [[Jerry Darcy]] devised the card type. He said the aim was to turn storylines from the films, such as carbon freezing or destroying planets with the Death Star, into viable deck strategies, at a time when "numbers" decks dominated and the game had become "burdened by edge-case mechanics".<ref name="holo1">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q_wPilA_ofA&t=1790s Star Wars CCG - 11/11/20 Holotheatre - with Dan & Kendall - Interview: Jerry Darcy], Star Wars CCG, YouTube (uploaded 12 November 2020), at 29:50. Transcript: [[Holotheatre/11 November 2020 transcript]].</ref> His first drafts expanded the [[Epic Event]] template to almost the whole card, leaving no room for an image. The two-sided design came to him at a mall pizza lunch with other Decipher staff, when he saw a pepperoni on the underside of a colleague's slice and realized that "cards have two sides".<ref name="holo1-3228">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q_wPilA_ofA&t=1948s Star Wars CCG - 11/11/20 Holotheatre - with Dan & Kendall - Interview: Jerry Darcy], Star Wars CCG, YouTube (uploaded 12 November 2020), at 32:28. Transcript: [[Holotheatre/11 November 2020 transcript]].</ref>

== Examples ==
Special Edition Objectives include [[Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize]] and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers]].
